messages:
Sara (Marketing): Quick sync — final runbook for the Open House demo track tomorrow. Need confirmations: swag pickup, posters, speaker AV, lead-routing QR and demo laptop builds. Packing list below. Who's picking up swag from the warehouse?
Alex (Growth): I can grab swag at 4pm today from the warehouse. ETA to venue ~5:30p.
Mike Ops: Thanks Alex. Can you also pick up the poster tubes and the rolling case? They said both are in bay C3.
Alex (Growth): Yep C3. Adding to my list.
Jessica - Design: Posters are the 24x36 matte prints. Please handle with care — one of the corners has a protective sleeve. Also I left the easel and Velcro strips in the rolling case.
Lina (Field): Who's staffing the demo table during the 6:30pm session? I can cover 6:15–7:00 but have a call at 7:05.
Sara (Marketing): Plan: Lina 6:15–7:00, Alex 7:00–8:00, Sara 8:00–9:00. Can everyone confirm handoff at 7:00?
Alex (Growth): Confirmed.
Mike Ops: I'll handle setup 5:45–6:15 and teardown at 9:15.
Lina (Field): Good. Do we have enough handouts for the lead follow-up (one-pager + stickers)?
Jessica - Design: Handouts: 120 one-pagers, 200 stickers. Swag box has 150 tees (S-XL mix), 200 stickers, 140 laptop stickers, 120 one-pagers. We should reorder if more tees are needed.
Sara (Marketing): Budget won't allow another tee order. Let's protect the tees for demo prize winners only. Use stickers and one-pagers for lead-handout.
Alex (Growth): For lead capture — we'll use the QR landing page that maps to the demo-specific funnel. Can someone verify the QR is on the poster and the one-pager?
Jessica - Design: QR added to both. Link: https://redwood.in/openhouse-demo (shortened for print).
Mike Ops: AV check: speaker podium needs HDMI + adapter. Speaker Johansen is bringing her own laptop (USB-C). We should have HDMI->USB-C adapter + spare HDMI cable.
Sara (Marketing): Mike — can you pack adapters? Also mic setup: lav + backup handheld.
Mike Ops: On it. Mic checklist: lav mic, spare battery pack, handheld mic, mic stand.
Lina (Field): Demo laptop image — who baked the final build? We need offline demo to avoid flaky wifi.
Alex (Growth): I created a golden image yesterday and copied it to an external SSD. Image label: redwood-demo-2024-07-01.img. Boot-tested on a ThinkPad.
Lina (Field): Perfect. Can you attach the SSD to the kit and label it in sharpie?
Alex (Growth): Will do.
Sara (Marketing): Lead routing: After each demo we scan badge or use QR. Post-event follow-up sequence: 1) instant thank-you email with calendar link, 2) 48-hour technical deep-dive invite, 3) sales reachout for high-fit leads. Alex — map the QR to a tagging param so we know demo vs booth leads.
Alex (Growth): Using ?source=openhouse-demo. We can filter in HubSpot.
Jessica - Design: Small ask — please take a hero photo of the booth for socials at 7:15 (golden hour). I'll post live story.
Lina (Field): I'll take the photo. Also reminder: venue security requires exhibitor badges for teardown. Mike — do we have printed badges for the crew?
Mike Ops: Printed badges are in the rolling case.
Sara (Marketing): Swag distribution rules: 1 per person unless they enter the raffle. Raffle sign-up via QR that ties to email. We need a clipboard and pen.
Alex (Growth): I have a clipboard.
Mike Ops: Shipping labels for returning demo hardware — where are they?
Jessica - Design: Labels are in the kit envelope with the packing list.
Sara (Marketing): Packing list (copy from kit):
```
- Rolling case (posters, easel, Velcro)
- Swag box (tees, stickers, one-pagers)
- Demo laptop + SSD image
- HDMI cable + HDMI->USB-C adapters (2)
- Lav mic + handheld mic + spare batteries
- Raffle clipboard + pens
- Business cards + name badges
- Printed return shipping labels
- Extension cord + power strip
- Gaffer tape + cable ties
```
Mike Ops: Minor ask — can someone confirm venue load-in time with the production contact? I don't want us waiting curbside.
Sara (Marketing): Production contact: Maya (maya@venuepro.co), load-in window 5:00–6:00pm per contract. I'll ping Maya now.
EventBot: Reminder: Venue access window opens at 17:00. Loader ETA must be declared by 16:30 to reserve dock.
Sara (Marketing): Update — Maya confirmed dock reserved for 5:15–5:45. Loader will help unload.
Lina (Field): Heads up: Johansen's talk needs a clicker and projector resolution set to 1920x1080. Mike please confirm projector supports that.
Mike Ops: I tested projector yesterday; 1080p supported. I'll bring a USB clicker as backup.
Alex (Growth): Post-event lead triage: I'll own initial qualification and tag as 'event:openhouse-demo'. Sara, who owns the nurture copy?
Sara (Marketing): I'll write the 48-hour technical deep-dive email. Alex — send list by 10am Monday.
Jessica - Design: One more: add small vinyl sticker to the demo laptop that says "Demo unit — do not unplug". I left a sheet in the kit.
Alex (Growth): Noted.
Sara (Marketing): OK team — last ask: quick 5-minute huddle at 5:50pm at the loading dock to confirm roles. If anything changes, post here. Thanks all! :rocket:
